description: LCAD EcoScreen 2.02 generates life-cycle inventories for anaerobic-digestion configurations. Users set 46 process parameters, with defaults, and the model tracks dry matter, carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus while maintaining mass and energy balances. This resource is provided by Martínez Arce, Andrés; Styles, David; O'Flaherty, Vincent. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The maintained workbook is a screening model. Default parameters require checking against the system being assessed. The page does not establish reuse or maintenance beyond the originating study or small project. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
